# Routing, Dark Liquidity, and Auctions {#plan-ch14}

::: {.planned-chapter}
Planned
:::

Extends the action from trading speed to venue, order type, and trading mechanism.

**Subtopics.** Fragmented liquidity; fees and rebates; latency; fill quality; venue-specific toxicity; dark pools and conditional liquidity; information leakage; price protection; contextual bandits; constrained routing; opening and closing auctions; imbalance information; crossing opportunities; joint control of schedule, aggressiveness, and venue.
